mentions.name: Embed Workflow
mentions.description: This is an embeddable workflow builder for SaaS platforms, letting each platform's end users design and run their own workflows inside the host product. The team is bootstrapped, has been at it for 5+ years, and is currently finishing a workflow testing interface for the builder.
mentions.audience: SaaS platforms that want to offer embedded, end-user-designed workflow automation inside their own products
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Embed Workflow (https://embedworkflow.com), an embeddable workflow builder for SaaS platforms. Your users design and run their own workflows inside your product.
